verdict.rationale: Bevy has a community-curated Assets page listing third-party assets, plugins, learning resources and apps. Its plugin-based architecture (add_plugins) supports a package ecosystem, and community members describe the community as lively. The evidence does not show a large, integrated asset store with ready-made models and tools. Missing for 10: evidence of ecosystem scale, a first-party asset store or marketplace, ready-made models/art packs, and independent corroboration of plugin breadth or quality.
